personality_one_liner: A vibrant, energetic, and touchable experience that makes deal-hunting feel like an exciting game.

spacing.rule: Make the interface feel touchable with chunky cards and oversized tap areas. Use controlled asymmetry to create energy.

do's: Use glass on Bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Use glass on Sticky headers over scrolling content
Use glass on 'Live Now' floating tags over images
dont's: Never apply glass to every button, list rows, or chips

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Prime location access and category preferences playfully
screens.layout: Full-bleed playful scenes with a large primary CTA fixed at the bottom. Use brand-tinted gradient backdrops.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Primary discovery hub combining Map, Feed, and Reels

states.empty: Playful illustration saying no deals nearby
states.error: Error loading deals with retry button

screens.layout: Top search bar with category shortcuts (pills) underneath. Segmented control to switch between Map, Feed, Reels. Feed: Deals carousel with countdown timers and bold percent-off badges. Use chunky cards with image scrims for text readability.

screens.name: Deal Detail
screens.purpose: Showcase specific deal, urgency, and trigger the claim action
screens.layout: Hero image with top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Embedded video placeholder if applicable. Large price before/after, prominent countdown timer. Sticky 'Claim Deal' CTA pinned at the bottom above safe area.

screens.name: Store Profile
screens.purpose: Showcase merchant details, location, and all active deals

states.loading: Skeleton layout for cover and deals
states.empty: No active deals for this store

screens.layout: Cover image with glass header overlay. Store details section below. Follow button. List of 'Active Deals' as chunky cards.

screens.name: Claim Flow
screens.purpose: Generate QR code upon deal claim

states.error: Claim failed due to limit reached

screens.layout: Modal or bottom sheet. Success animation followed by a large QR code and a redemption code below it. Clear instructions on how to use it at the store.

screens.name: My Claims
screens.purpose: Track claimed deals status (Active / Redeemed / Expired)

states.empty: Illustration showing no claims yet, prompt to discover deals

screens.layout: Top tabs for Active/Redeemed/Expired. List of claimed deals using surfaceSecondary cards. Each card has a status badge.

screens.name: Favorites

states.empty: Empty state illustration with text 'You haven't followed any merchants yet'

screens.layout: Grid or list of followed store profiles. Each card has the store cover and logo.

onboarding_scene.alt: People enjoying food and drinks at happy hour

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow 4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT personality strictly. Use chunky cards, rounded containers, and oversized tap areas.
Implement the gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) pattern on ALL hero images or deal cards where text overlays imagery.
Primary CTAs ('Claim Deal', 'Continue') MUST be sticky at the bottom of the screen, floating above the scrolling content with safe-area clearance.
Ensure 'Live Now' countdown badges use a strong accent color (like warning or error) to convey urgency, paired with playful animation like a slight pulse if possible.
For the Feed vs Map vs Reels toggle on the Home screen, use a stylized segmented control or pill chips.
Apply haptic feedback on tab changes, filter chip selections, and when claiming a deal (success haptic). Serialize these in the dev output.
Use expo-image for all images. Ensure empty states fill the screen and use the designated empty state illustration.
Ensure UI hierarchy is obvious without text overload. Use padding (md/lg) generously around content to prevent a cluttered dashboard look.
